verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client and tooling platform, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence only shows Insomnia acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers (insomnia-docs-30, insomnia-docs-46), which is the opposite role. insomnia-docs-14 mentions using MCP clients to connect Insomnia to Konnect, but it does not document an Insomnia-provided MCP server that agents can connect to.
